effects.trigger: If prevented access or removed from the diner against its will
effects.persistence: begins between five (5) and ten (10) minutes after removal
constraints: SCP-1295-1 is prevented access to the diner or removed from it against its will

evidence.locator: Those caught in an area beginning with approx. one hundred (100) meters from SCP-1295-1 exhibit extreme lethargy and complete lack of any self preservation instincts, making even a simple accident potentially lethal.

effects.trigger: If prevented access or removed from the diner against its will
effects.persistence: begins between two (2) and three (3) hours after removal
constraints: SCP-1295-2 is prevented access to the diner or removed from it against its will

evidence.locator: Those caught in an area beginning with approx. five hundred (500) meters from SCP-1295-2 lose their ability to distinguish between edible and inedible matter, and will often endanger themselves or others in attempts to consume unsuitable nourishment (metal, toxic waste, living flesh, etc.).

effects.target: microbial lifeforms associated with the bodies
effects.trigger: If prevented access or removed from the diner against its will
constraints: SCP-1295-3 is prevented access to the diner or removed from it against its will

evidence.locator: The bodies of those caught in an area of approx. fifty (50) meters around SCP-1295-3 will lose all microbial lifeforms associated with them.

effects.trigger: If prevented access or removed from the diner against its will
effects.persistence: begins thirty (30) to forty (40) minutes after removal
constraints: SCP-1295-4 is prevented access to the diner or removed from it against its will

evidence.locator: Those caught in an area beginning with approx. one hundred and fifty (150) meters from SCP-1295-4 will experience a sharp increase of self-preservation instincts, to the point of paranoia and acute hypochondria.
SCP-1295's daily routine is not to be interrupted under any circumstances.
